result:
I’d make curiosity stronger than contempt.

I’d want people to genuinely try to understand someone before deciding who they are—especially when that person’s beliefs or choices differ from their own. Not universal agreement, just less haste to condemn. Understanding someone doesn’t mean you have to approve of them.
